textTemplates.name: SVC_VisitBranch2ActionText
textTemplates.text: Advise the customer that an alternate email address cannot be used or they can engage via chat or will need to visit a branch for their request to capture an alternate email address.

textTemplates.name: SVC_VisitBranch2ScriptText
textTemplates.text: Apologies {!SVC_MainFlowContact.FirstName}, I am unable to send the document to another email address other than the one on your profile. To receive a copy of your Natis document for your vehicle, you can engage with us via chat on the Mobile App so we can capture an alternate email address for you and send you the document or alternatively, you can visit your nearest branch with a form of identification so they can help you with updating your contact details to include your specified email address. Once that has been completed, please contact us again so we can send you the document.

textTemplates.name: SVC_VisitBranchActionText
textTemplates.text: Advise the customer that there is no email address on their profile and they can engage via chat or will need to visit a branch for their request.

textTemplates.name: SVC_VisitBranchScriptText
textTemplates.text: Apologies {!SVC_MainFlowContact.FirstName}, I don't seem to see an email address on your profile. In order to receive a copy of your Natis document for your vehicle, you can engage with us via chat on the Mobile App so we can capture an email address for you and send you the document or alternatively, you can visit your nearest branch with a form of identification so they can help you with updating your contact details to include your specified email address. Once that has been completed, please contact us again so we can send you the document.
